body: add --tag X --tag Y now creates one blended style ('style hybrid', distinct from the existing subject-mashup vocabulary) instead of forcing N separate generations. Surfaced and fixed a real slugifyPO bug (dropped punctuation between spaces left a bare double hyphen, rejected by IDUNA's slug regex). Commit emily.cli 8e5e6d7.
title: Style hybrids (repeated --tag) + slugifyPO double-hyphen fix
